Section Four: Sentence Comprehension. Instructions: For questions 33 and 34, choose the sentence with the closest meaning to the head sentence from the four alternatives given, and blacken the letter of your choice on the separate answer sheet provided.
 All students but one got above average marks in English.
 Which sentence has the closest meaning to the head sentence?
options: All students got above average marks in English.
Only one student failed to get above average marks in English.
All students did not get above average marks in English.
Everybody got above average mark in English.
explanation: The head sentence, 'All students **but one** got above average marks,' means that one single student did **not** get above average marks. This is equivalent to saying 'Only one student **failed** to get above average marks in English.' Option A and D mean *every* student succeeded, and Option C means *no* student succeeded, which contradicts the head sentence.

Addis Ababa University, which is the oldest university in the country, has changed its admission policy.
 Which sentence has the closest meaning to the head sentence?
options: Addis Ababa University admits students based on new rules and regulations.
Addis Ababa University has grown old with its admission policy.
Addis Ababa University has a conducive learning atmosphere.
Joining Addis Ababa University has now become easy.
explanation: To **change its admission policy** means that the university now has a different set of rules or criteria for admitting students. Option A, 'Addis Ababa University admits students based on new rules and regulations,' is the sentence that best captures the meaning of a changed admission policy.
